  • Red Lettuce Seed is sold in the Leafy Market "Seed & Fertilizer" tab at 48C (Basic quality). Video-observedGames Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
  • Season: Spring · Growth time: 3 days · Multi-harvest: none (one harvest per planting). Video-observedGames Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)

What to do next

Use this entry to plan a one-harvest Spring crop: confirm the Leafy Market seed listing, plant it, and keep it watered through the 3-day growth window.

Price and income boundary

  • Player sell price per head: unknown. Crop income settles as one combined Farming total in the daily settlement, so per-crop sell prices cannot be read off the settlement screen and none is published here. UnknownGames Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
  • Theoretical framework only (not an observed outcome): profit per occupied day = (sell price − 48C) ÷ 3 once a sell price is captured. Single-sourceGames Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
